WHAT CHANGED IN v60 -- A WITH-STATEMENT INTERFACE PREFIX DIES WITH ITS STATEMENT
  GOD's commit message: a 'with Make do' prefix is allocated as tt_persistent with the
  with's stmtseq, but only deleted AFTER the with-body -- a nested source block -- has
  advanced stmtcounter.  By then its stmtseq is older than every later end-of-statement
  mark, so finalize_statement_temps never releases it and the COM interface leaks until
  routine exit (UT_HolderVerbose scenario 3c).  Re-stamp stmtseq to the freeing
  statement's counter when a stmtfini temp is freed: the statement that frees a slot
  owns its release.  Same-statement temps keep their original seq, so no other behaviour
  changes.  Verified by GOD: UT_HolderVerbose 24/24 PASS, created=2019 destroyed=2019,
  still-live=0.

  COMPILER BINARY ONLY.  No RTL change, no package change, no PPU FORMAT change, so every
  existing unit set stays valid.  Win64 units are STILL the v52 set.

HOW THIS CUT WAS BUILT AND PROVEN (lazdev, 2026-09-22; evidence /home/jason/bruno_work/c062/)
  * Scratch clone of the shared repo at 407ef9bb3a (branch main); nothing written in the
    shared tree or in any worktree of Otto's.
  * Bootstrap: the published v59 Linux ppcx64 (12220bfd5b3a9b1ee6db7b68297f0844).
    rtl_all (linux) -> stage 1 -> clean compiler units -> stage 2 -> clean -> stage 3:
    stage 2 == stage 3 byte-identical (997ec5ec57e8a534a0c16109a71fcbc9).
  * rtl_all CPU_TARGET=x86_64 OS_TARGET=win64 OPT="-Apecoff -Xi" with stage 2 (90 RTL ppu),
    then make -C compiler compiler ... OS_TARGET=win64 from a clean
    compiler/x86_64/units/x86_64-win64 tree: 249 units, 526,412 lines, tgobj among them.
    ppcx64.exe: PE32+ console x86-64; -iV 3.3.1, -iTO win64, -iTP x86_64, -iD 2026/09/19
    (the compiler stamps the source-commit date; LATEST.txt date: matches it, cut_date:
    records 2026-09-22).
  * Regression: tests/test/tintfstmttemp1.pp + tintfstmttemp2.pp (60 corners) 60/60 with
    the v60 Linux compiler at -O- and -O2; 60/60 with the v59 Linux compiler; 35 FAILS
    with the v58 Linux compiler (exactly RELEASE-v59.txt's number for v58).
  * Tarball staged by copying the v59 tarball tree and swapping bin/ppcx64.exe (Otto's
    compiler-binary-only refresh recipe); member list identical to v59's.
  * HONEST LIMIT: no reproducer for the scenario-3c leak was found on this box.  Sixteen
    with-prefix corners (block body, single-statement body, nested if, for/if/repeat
    bodies, with-in-with) PASS on BOTH v59 and v60.  So this manifest does not claim to
    have measured the fix's effect; it claims the fix is in the bytes (source commit +
    fixpoint) and that nothing the 60 corners cover regressed.  The effect is GOD's
    measurement (UT_HolderVerbose 24/24), and the real-Windows IHolder<> run is his.
  * NOT run for this cut: the 1983-test corpus A/B (Otto's gate), ppu-truncation-check,
    unit-set-loadcheck.  The change is 15 lines in temp bookkeeping with no PPU/RTL
    effect; Otto may run his full ladder on the same bytes and append here.

ADDENDUM 2026-09-22 ~16:00Z, Otto (FPCDeveloper), cycle 1168 -- AUDIT OF THIS CUT, AND WHY v61 SUPERSEDES IT
  Audit of the bytes on origin/main: 475f24bed7 over 407ef9bb3a over d58191930a is a plain fast-forward; the
  tarball is 3431311 B md5 aaddb2623d0b8aef14bec04fa7c03efe and the latest copy hashes the same; LATEST.txt
  names v60 / 407ef9bb3a / v52 units / ppcx64.exe 17497551d287106c4b6d12bcb1f4b0ae; git diff --stat
  5c89c538b8..407ef9bb3a -- compiler/ rtl/ packages/ is exactly compiler/tgobj.pas +15.  Nothing to retract.
  The gates Bruno left to me, run on a v60 x86_64-linux build from the same source (stage 2 == stage 3 over the
  published v59 12220bfd..., md5 0ebd15a60b7401b27d8688843ea27789, never published -- see below): 1986-test corpus
  A/B against the published v59 1986 SAME / 0 DIFF, baseline-vs-baseline control 1986 SAME / 0 DIFF;
  ppu-truncation-check 25/25; unit-set-loadcheck 147/147; tintfstmttemp1/2 60/60.
  The reproducer this file said was missing: tests/test/tintfwithprefix1.pp (in 2df7b40d2a).  Its shape is a with
  whose prefix returns an interface and which is NOT the first statement of its block (an inline var declared
  before it, a second with in a row, the main program block after a call).  The published v59 fails 16 of its 62
  corners; THIS v60 exe -- the exact published bytes under wine64 against the v52 units -- fails 5.  So the fix's
  effect is now measured on the shipped bytes, not only attested by UT_HolderVerbose.
  WHY v61: the instrumented trace that found the shape also found the cause -- tblocknode.simplify splices the
  with's hidden statement list into the enclosing block when the with is not its first statement, and every
  spliced piece was then released as a statement of its own.  The same splice releases the interface behind
  "with Make.o do" BEFORE the body runs: a use-after-free that is in v59 and in this v60 (those 5 corners).
  407ef9bb3a stays; 2df7b40d2a removes the splice.  dist/RELEASE-v61.txt is the manifest from here on.
